candidates.limits: General capability does not qualify this literature-reading task, another role or native scientific certification. Pin model, effort, harness and context; backend identity may not be observable.
candidates.motivation: Public documentation positions Sol for complex work at lower cost than Astra; compare exact role configurations using source-grounded behavior and measured resource use.

candidates.limits: Model size, price and broad performance do not establish sufficiently low false exclusion.
candidates.motivation: Documented efficient model for focused high-volume work. Proposed local screening profile is medium effort, pending separate title and abstract qualification.

candidates.limits: Do not assume higher effort or a stronger general model always improves this reader. Effort and endpoint must be qualified explicitly.
candidates.motivation: Documented strongest OpenAI candidate for demanding reasoning/research; consider when it improves grounded judgments enough to justify measured resource use.

candidates.limits: Claude Code and API authentication, defaults and telemetry differ. Do not translate OpenAI effort by matching its name.
candidates.motivation: Current documented high-volume classification/extraction candidate; first economical Claude profile to consider.

candidates.limits: Optional comparator, not a requirement to test a third Claude. Role approval remains separate.
candidates.motivation: Documented middle tier; evaluate if it can lower reader cost or improve screening relative to the other accessible Claude profiles.

candidates.limits: Vendor research evaluations do not establish consciousness-literature eligibility judgments. Exact effort and serving route need evaluation.
candidates.motivation: Documented knowledge-work and reasoning candidate; first Claude reader configuration to consider when available.

candidates.limits: 320B total parameters despite 18B active; do not treat it as a laptop-size model. Hosted FlashX, general API, Coding Plan and self-hosting are distinct profiles.
candidates.motivation: Open-weight multimodal candidate with long-context support; economical hosted GLM option to test for screening and reading.

candidates.limits: Text-only profile needs a qualified path for decisive figures. Open weights under a custom license must not be described as universally permissive open source. Reasoning controls low/high/max are provider-specific.
candidates.motivation: Stronger long-context GLM candidate to compare when accessible; public reasoning/agent evidence motivates evaluation only.

candidates.limits: 35B total is not 3B resident memory. Pin quantization, weight revision and backend; measure full-context and concurrent memory on the actual host. Not claimed to be the latest or strongest Qwen. Reader use requires additional qualification.
candidates.motivation: Smaller open-weight text/vision candidate with documented local serving support; worth measuring when local compute is available.

candidates.limits: Large server model despite Flash naming. Exact hosted API identifier must be discovered, not inferred from the weight repository. Reasoning effort integers are not equivalent to another provider's xhigh.
candidates.motivation: Optional open-weight multimodal comparator with documented document and long-context evaluations.

evaluation_dimensions: restraint about null results and equivalence
qualification_rule: Availability, authorization and task-specific qualification are separate. Exact configurations need source-grounded evidence before approved use; users are not required to evaluate the entire catalog.
ranking_scope: No global model-quality ranking; qualification applies to the exact model, effort, adapter, context and scientific role.
selection_order: Establish accessible, authorized exact role configurations and explicit resource limits.
Check source-grounded behavior for that role; keep unknown performance and costs explicit.
Recommend the least costly accessible configuration that passes those checks; compare justified alternatives only within the commissioning budget.
selection_policy: Recommend one accessible configuration and evaluate only justified alternatives within the user's agreed commissioning budget.
